# Money
## Your Bank Account
Every character has [color=lightgreen]their own bank account[/color] that carries over from shift to shift. A new character starts with [color=lightgreen]$5000[/color].
Each character slot has a separate account. Deleting a character deletes its account too.
## Paydays
NanoTrasen pays the crew [color=lightgreen]every 30 minutes[/color] straight into their accounts. How much depends on your job, from $250 for passengers up to $1000 for the captain. Heads of staff earn the most, assistants and interns the least.
Every 5 minutes NT checks whether you are actually working. You count as present when you are [color=lightgreen]in your body and alive or in crit[/color]. You count as missing when you are: - dead - ghosted, even if your body is still alive - disconnected (SSD) - not on the station yet, if you joined late
Your pay depends on how many checks you missed since the last payday: - [color=lightgreen]Full pay[/color] if you missed less than half of them. - [color=yellow]Half pay[/color] if you missed half or more, but were present at least once. - [color=palevioletred]Nothing[/color] if you were never present.
## Shift End Bonus
If your body reaches Central Command on the evacuation shuttle, you get a [color=lightgreen]shift end bonus of two paychecks[/color]. It follows the same full, half or nothing rule, counted over the whole shift.
Dying on the way there does not cost you the bonus if you worked the rest of the shift. Staying behind on the station gets you nothing.
## Your PDA
Your PDA shows your balance. Payments and the bonus also show up as a message on screen and in chat, but [color=lightgreen]only while you carry your own PDA[/color]. Lose it and you still get paid, you just won't be told.
A PDA always shows the balance of the person it was issued to. Whoever picks up your PDA can see how much money you have.
## ATMs
ATMs let you [color=lightgreen]withdraw spesos as cash[/color] from your account. NT disabled the deposit slots, so once money is withdrawn it stays cash.
Cash is a physical item like any other. It can be traded, lost or stolen, so only take out what you need.
